decisive_findings.detail: Source, installed, and cache all declare 0.0.11, but the source manifests differ from the byte-identical installed/cache manifests.

The live source has 22 skill directories and six current project-agent manifests, while plugin-manifest-draft.json lists 13 legacy skills and omits all eight canonical skills. Installed and cache trees contain 13 legacy skills and no current .codex/agents manifests.

Source guidance still routes fresh operators through proposal-era lanes, legacy skills, and global custom-agent copying. No current HUGPKG, repo-scoped marketplace catalog, PATH executable, plugin command, or MCP runtime registration proves the current source product.

The host plugin-list probe observed enabled installed 0.0.11 but attempted PATH-alias creation and was denied; it is not accepted as a zero-effect read proof. App-registry, Plugins UI, and neutral-root fresh-session discovery remain unobserved.

root_actions_after_independent_acceptanc: reserve and apply unique source version 0.0.12
close the root-owned manifest and package inventory over the canonical eight skills and six current agents
adopt or reject the repo-scoped marketplace catalog through root manifest authority
build and independently compare two current HUGPKG artifacts
separately prove isolated install, installed/cache byte identity, app registry, Plugins UI, neutral-root discovery, runtime identity, and representative product behavior
